nodes.label: The bibliography as the one predictive index (E = 6)
nodes.rationale: Twenty-two sources over seven cells admitting six it does not carry; under exhaustive relabelling E falls from six to two and never to zero, so it is irreducible like the asteroid belt and unlike the periodic table under Janet — yet its empty cells are occupiable, which makes it the only place in the book where a prediction is both available and true.

nodes.label: Irreducible does not mean unoccupiable (a third verdict for §16.7.1)
nodes.rationale: §16.7.1 sorted defects into artefacts of the layout and facts about the world; the bibliography is the second kind with fillable cells, so the two verdicts are not exhaustive. Closure abolishes prediction but cannot abolish the bibliography, because E(search) > 0 always by §27.1.
